title: Cachapas
description: Thick, sweet fresh-corn pancakes folded over slices of soft white cheese that melt against the hot griddle cake.
notes: Queso de mano is the classic cheese. Fresh mozzarella is the nearest easy substitute.

ingredients.name: sweet corn kernels
ingredients.note: fresh from about 5 cobs, or frozen

steps.text: Blend the corn kernels, precooked cornmeal, sugar, salt, milk, and egg to a thick, slightly coarse batter.
Melt a little butter on a griddle and pour on a ladle of batter, spreading it into a 15 cm round.
Cook until bubbles break the surface and the underside is browned, then flip and cook the other side.
steps.tip: The batter is wetter than a pancake's. Flip once, carefully, with a wide spatula.

steps.text: Lay a thick slice of queso de mano on half, fold over, and serve warm so the cheese softens.
